text:
Sam: Quick idea for the upcoming "Intro to Redwood Inference" webinar 0 attendees expected. What if we issue 75 dynamic credits to verified attendees + a 3-step "onboarding coach" microflow that walks them through first API call? Goal: shorten time-to-first-success and lift 7-day retention.

Ivy: Nice. Microflow = 3 tiny tasks in-app with checklist + progress bar? Could add a small leaderboard for early adopters. Keep privacy in mind.

Jon: Leaderboard could be a lightweight badge system, not public by default. For the experiment we can opt-in. Key metric: percent completing microflow and avg tokens used in first session.

Priya: Routing note 10% of registrants are enterprise leads. We should tag users with source=webinar_infer_75 and route enterprise to AE queue immediately. SDR gets rest. Also will send follow-up with templates + credit CTA at +6h.

Kait: For promo mechanics, dynamic credits only. Promo codes cause support churn. We'll attach credits server-side to account upon first verified login. Need a backend hook from auth service to billing to apply credits. ETA?

Sam: Backend hook + feature flag is fine. Require at least one API call to unlock credit redemption to prevent sharing. 10-day expiry.

Ivy: Prompt templates I can write. Suggest three personas: small-saas dev (create a 3-step onboarding flow), ops engineer (incident runbook summarizer), growth marketer (personalized outreach email + subject variants). Each template set = 4-5 snippets.

Jon: Can we include an example usage snippet in the follow-up email? e.g., a curl call and a JSON payload so they can run in <3 minutes.

Kait: I'll add a short sample in the email and in docs. Also add a one-click "run this prompt" in the in-app coach using a temp API key for the session. Security: temp key expires in 1 hour.

Priya: Email subjects A/B test: A = "75 credits + ready-made prompts from the webinar"; B = "Start building: 75 credits (expire in 10 days)". Send 60/40 to favor urgent variant.

Sam: Tracking events: webinar_attended, coach_started, coach_completed, credit_granted, credit_redeemed, first_api_call. Put schema in marketing/analytics/campaigns.md and tag events with utm_campaign=webinar_infer_75.

Ivy: Draft prompt sample for ops persona:
```
Prompt: "You are an on-call engineer. Given the incident log below, summarize the top 3 root causes and draft an incident retro note with next steps."
Variables: INCIDENT_LOG
Tone: technical, action-oriented
```

Jon: Love the tone. For the in-app coach steps: 1) Run example curl -> returns 1st gen, 2) Swap a variable in prompt, 3) Save template to library. Completion unlocks credit.

Kait: Eng-bot: merging branch feature/webinar-credits -> staging. CI green. Schedule for canary deploy tomorrow.

eng-bot: deploy queued - feature/webinar-credits -> staging at 2026-04-01T03:00:00Z. Canary flag enabled.

Sam: Action items: Ivy write full template sets (today), Kait build auth->billing hook + temp key (1 day), Jon add coach UX + example curl (today), Priya wire routing + email A/B (today), Sam will monitor metrics and share dashboard link. Check back tomorrow after staging smoke. :rocket:
